Recovered — claims that computed and were withdrawn for want of a proof — 15 machine-checked theorems of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit, one Lean namespace, wing the returned. 15 close by exhaustion over a finite domain (by decide). Every one is sealed live in the append-only ledger.

How these theorems are bound. "Entangled" is used in this deposit's honest sense: correlation by derivation, not quantum entanglement, and no information travels through it.

1 · Shared definitions. 3 definition(s) are used by two or more theorems, binding 43 pair(s); the theorems fall into 6 strand(s), the largest of 9. Most binding: units (7), pow9 (7), triad (2). 4 theorem(s) name no definition of the file and stand on their own statement.

2 · Imports. Built on: no other cluster. Built on it: no other cluster. Checking this cluster needs 1 file(s): src/proof/recovered.lean.

3 · The joint address. The 15 sealed receipts fold to 31d07f8b-f421-81f8-a182-748948c44492. Order-invariant: yes — the same root in reverse order. Altering one receipt changes it: yes, computed on this run. A content-address proves integrity, not truth.

4 · The address lattice. Each theorem sits at the seven ray values its page plots from its receipt, taken mod 9: a point of (ℤ/9)⁷. This cluster's centre is (0, 6, 1, 2, 8, 5, 6). Its nearest clusters, ranked by lift — pairs observed among each theorem's seven nearest points, over the pairs expected by chance from the two clusters' sizes: generated.lean (7 observed, 2.16 expected, lift 3.24), theorems.lean (4 observed, 1.33 expected, lift 3), speed.lean (3 observed, 1.83 expected, lift 1.64). A lift near 1 is what chance gives. Mean distance between two of its theorems: 15.79; from one of its theorems to a theorem of another cluster: 15.51. A receipt is a hash, so nearness on this lattice is a property of the addresses, not of the mathematics; the mathematical binding is (1) and (2). Chance, measured: over 200 reshufflings of which cluster each point belongs to (seeded, so every rebuild gives the same numbers), a best lift at least this high arose in 26.0% of them — consistent with chance.

Prior art. every fact here is standard: the units of ℤ/9 are {1,2,4,5,7,8}, their product is −1 (Wilson), 2 generates them with order 6, and the Pisano period of Fibonacci mod 9 is 24. Textbook material, credited. What is NOT prior art is that these particular statements sat WITHDRAWN in this deposit's ledger, each recorded as "not backed by a Lean proof. Its evidence is a TypeScript test", while every one is decidable in a line. Per-theorem prior-art searches — OEIS, zbMATH Open, OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv — are recorded, with what was searched, where and when, in the living ledger src/proof/novelty.json. No novelty is claimed here.
